dominant_strengths: Clear hierarchy with bold gallery title and concise descriptive subhead makes the page's purpose immediately legible
Card grid is functionally sound with consistent thumbnail/title/description rhythm aiding rapid browsing
Black header anchors the layout and gives the bright lego mascot a focal contrast point
dominant_weaknesses: Palette is fragmented: neon green CTA, purple A-Z pill, magenta logo accent, and pastel hero illustration never resolve into a system
Hero illustration feels generic stock-isometric and undermines the credibility of a curated design-systems authority
Toggle pills (A-Z / Most Recent) sit awkwardly centered with heavy purple fill that competes with the brand mint
fix_priorities: Consolidate accent colors to one primary plus one secondary; reassign CTA, pill, and logo to that restricted system
Replace or restyle the hero illustration with something more editorially distinctive and on-brand
Refine the sort toggle into a quieter segmented control so cards become the visual hero
Tighten typographic scale between H1, body, and card eyebrow labels for a more confident editorial voice
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral utility dominates with clear browsing affordances, but visceral polish and reflective brand memorability lag behind.
rationale.intent_fit: It functionally delivers a curated design-systems gallery, but the chrome itself doesn't exemplify the design-system rigor it catalogs.
